packageRules.prBodyTemplate:
This PR updates the Traefik Helm chart from `{{currentVersion}}` to `{{newVersion}}`.

### Changes
- Updates `packages/traefik/package.yaml` with new chart URL
- Existing patches in `packages/traefik/generated-changes/` will be automatically applied
- Charts will be rebuilt with `make charts` in CI

### Testing
The CI workflow will:
1. Run `make prepare` to apply patches to the new version
2. Run `make validate` to ensure patches apply cleanly
3. Run `make charts` to generate final chart packages

Please review the generated charts before merging.
